From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Annual ranking of the top 2000 public companies published by Forbes magazine

The **_Forbes_ Global 2000** is an annual ranking of the top 2000 public companies in the world, published by _[Forbes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes "Forbes")_ magazine. "The Global 2000" annual ranking is assembled by _Forbes_ using an assessment of four equally-weighted metrics: sales, [profit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Profit_(accounting) "Profit (accounting)"), [assets](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asset "Asset") and [market value](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Market_capitalization "Market capitalization").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes_Global_2000#cite_note-method-1) The list has been published annually since 2003.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Annual ranking of the top 2000 public companies published by Forbes magazine

The **_Forbes_ Global 2000** is an annual ranking of the top 2000 public companies in the world, published by _[Forbes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes "Forbes")_ magazine. "The Global 2000" annual ranking is assembled by _Forbes_ using an assessment of four equally-weighted metrics: sales, [profit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Profit_(accounting) "Profit (accounting)"), [assets](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asset "Asset") and [market value](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Market_capitalization "Market capitalization").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes_Global_2000#cite_note-method-1) The list has been published annually since 2003.
